thi-ap7:1.1: Kaṭacchubhikkhadāyikā.] Piṇḍacāraṃcarantassa Tissanāmassa satthuno / kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ paggayha Buddhaseṭṭhass adās' ahaṃ // //
thi-ap7:2.1: Paṭiggahetvāsambuddho Tisso lokagganāyako / vīthiyā saṇṭhito satthā akā me anumodanaṃ: // //
thi-ap7:4.1: Paññāsaṃcakkavattīnaṃ mahesittaṃ karissasi / manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ paṭilacchasi sabbadā. // //
thi-ap7:5.1: Sampattiṃanubhotvāna pabbajissas' akiñcanā / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissas' anāsavā.' // //
thi-ap7:6.1: Idaṃvatvāna sambuddho Tisso lokagganāyako / *nabhaṃ* abbhuggami vīro haṃsarājā va ambare. // //
thi-ap7:7.1: Sudinnaṃme dānavaraṃ suyiṭṭhā yāgasampadā / Kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ datvāna pattā 'haṃ acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
thi-ap7:8.1: Dvenavuteito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhikkhadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
thi-ap7:12.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Kaṭacchubhikkhadāyikā bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti.
